build_fetch_openrouter_models: fetch the live OpenRouter model catalog and return curated model IDs with descriptions
build_validate_requested_model: validate a model name against a provider's live API and return acceptance with auto-correction suggestions
build_parse_model_input: parse a provider:model string into a normalized provider ID and model name tuple
build_list_available_providers: list all available providers with their labels, aliases, and authentication status
build_format_model_pricing_table: format a column-aligned pricing table from model IDs and their prompt/completion prices
build_get_pricing_for_provider: fetch live pricing data for a provider like openrouter or nous from their /v1/models endpoint
build_normalize_copilot_model_id: normalize a Copilot model ID by resolving aliases and catalog lookups to the canonical ID
build_detect_provider_for_model: detect the best provider for a given model name based on static catalogs and available credentials
